h1: New Year’s Eve party ideas at home
lead: Canadians search for “new years eve party ideas at home for adults”, “for families” and “for kids”. Here are ideas for food, games and the countdown – plus an easy way to gather everyone’s phone photos and videos after midnight.
body: ## Pick your format
- Adults’ night in: cocktails or mocktails, a grazing board and a playlist from the past year.
- Family party: games, an early “kids’ countdown” and a late one for the grown-ups.
- Potluck: everyone brings a dish – tourtière, butter tarts or Nanaimo bars always go fast.
## Games and activities
- Year-in-review quiz: news, music and family moments from 2026.
- Resolutions jar: write them now, read them next December.
- Board games or a card tournament before midnight.
- A noisemaker and confetti station for the countdown.
## Kids’ countdown
Many families do a fake midnight at 8 or 9 pm: set a timer, count down together and let the kids blow their noisemakers.
## All the photos in one place with a QR code
Every guest takes photos and videos on their phone. With an event album on Albums you collect them all:
1. Create an album, e.g. “NYE 2026 at the Martins’”.
2. Put the QR code on the fridge, the drinks table or in the invite.
3. Guests scan it with their phone camera and upload photos and videos in the browser – nothing to install.
4. Turn on Hold guest photos to review uploads before they appear.
5. On January 1, download the whole album as one ZIP file.
Guests who upload without signing in appear anonymously. Signed-in guests also get a private draft copy of only their own uploads.
